title: THE AIRPORTS AUTHORITY OF INDIA ACT, 1994
long_title: An Act to provide for the constitution of the Airports Authority of India and for the transfer and vesting of the undertakings of the International Airports Authority of India and the National Airports Authority to and in the Airports Authority of India so constituted for the better administration and cohesive management of airports and civil enclaves whereat air transport services are operated or are intended to be operated and of all aeronautical communication stations and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

sections.section_title: Short title, commencement and application
sections.text: (1) This Act may be called the Airports Authority of India Act, 1994. (2) It shall come into force on such date as the Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint. (3) It applies to all airports whereat air transport services are operated or are intended to be operated, all civil enclaves, and all aeronautical communication stations.

sections.section_title: Definitions
sections.text: Defines key terms including "airport", "aeronautical communication station", "Authority", "Chairperson", "civil enclave", "International Airports Authority", "member", "National Airports Authority", "prescribed", and other related expressions.

sections.section_title: Constitution and incorporation of the Authority
sections.text: With effect from such date as the Central Government may by notification appoint, there shall be constituted an Authority to be called the Airports Authority of India, which shall be a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal, and may sue and be sued in its name. The Authority shall consist of a Chairperson and not less than eight and not more than fourteen other members appointed by the Central Government.

sections.section_title: Disqualification for office of member
sections.text: A person shall be disqualified for being appointed as a member if he is of unsound mind, an undischarged insolvent, has been convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude, or has such financial or other interest as is likely to affect prejudicially his functions as a member.

sections.section_title: Term of office and conditions of service of members
sections.text: The Chairperson and other members shall hold office for such term as may be prescribed, and shall be entitled to such salaries and allowances and be subject to such conditions of service as may be prescribed.

sections.section_title: Vacation of office of member
sections.text: Provides for the circumstances in which the office of a member becomes vacant, including resignation, removal by the Central Government on prescribed grounds, and the procedure therefor.

sections.section_title: Eligibility of member for re-appointment
sections.text: A member shall be eligible for re-appointment on the expiration of his term of office.

sections.section_title: Meetings
sections.text: The Authority shall meet at such times and places and shall observe such rules of procedure in regard to the transaction of business at its meetings as may be provided by regulations; the Chairperson or, in his absence, any member chosen by the members present shall preside.

sections.section_title: Vacancies, etc., not to invalidate proceedings of the Authority
sections.text: No act or proceeding of the Authority shall be invalid merely by reason of any vacancy in, or any defect in the constitution of, the Authority, or any defect in the appointment of a person acting as a member, or any irregularity in procedure not affecting the merits of the case.

sections.section_title: Appointment of officers and other employees of the Authority
sections.text: The Authority may appoint such officers and other employees as it considers necessary for the efficient discharge of its functions under this Act, on such terms and conditions of service as may be determined by regulations.

sections.section_title: Authority to act on business principles
sections.text: In the discharge of its functions under this Act, the Authority shall act as far as possible on business principles.

sections.section_title: Functions of the Authority
sections.text: The Authority shall be responsible for the development, operation, management and maintenance of airports, civil enclaves and aeronautical communication stations; provision of air traffic services; establishment and maintenance of hotels, restaurants and other amenities; construction and management of cargo complexes; establishment of training centres; and such other functions as may be entrusted to it by the Central Government.

sections.section_title: Lease by the Authority
sections.text: The Authority may, with the previous approval of the Central Government, lease out any airport or civil enclave or any part thereof, or any aeronautical communication station or any facility or service, on such terms and conditions as may be approved by that Government.

sections.section_title: Undertakings of the International Airports Authority and the National Airports Authority to vest in the Authority
sections.text: On the appointed day, the undertakings of the International Airports Authority and the National Airports Authority shall stand transferred to and vest in the Airports Authority of India.

sections.section_title: General effect of vesting of undertaking in the Authority
sections.text: All assets, rights, powers, authorities and privileges, and all property, movable and immovable, of the two previous Authorities shall vest in the new Authority; all debts, liabilities and obligations shall also stand transferred.

sections.section_title: Licences, etc., to be deemed to have been granted to the Authority
sections.text: All licences, permits, quotas and exemptions granted to the previous Authorities shall be deemed to have been granted to the new Authority.

sections.section_title: Tax exemption or benefit to continue to have effect
sections.text: Any tax exemption or benefit available to the previous Authorities shall continue to be available to the new Authority.

sections.section_title: Guarantee to be operative
sections.text: Any guarantee given by the Central Government in respect of any liability of the previous Authorities shall continue to be operative in relation to the new Authority.

sections.section_title: Provisions in respect of officers and other employees of the International Airports Authority and the National Airports Authority
sections.text: Every officer and employee of the previous Authorities shall become an officer or employee of the new Authority on the same terms and conditions of service, and shall continue to hold office until duly terminated or until remuneration and conditions are duly altered.

sections.section_title: Compulsory acquisition of land for the Authority
sections.text: The Central Government may, for the purposes of this Act, acquire any land under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or any other law for the time being in force, and such acquisition shall be deemed to be for a public purpose.

sections.section_title: Contracts by the Authority
sections.text: Subject to the provisions of this Act, the Authority shall be competent to enter into and perform any contract necessary for the discharge of its functions under this Act.

sections.section_title: Mode of executing contracts on behalf of the Authority
sections.text: Every contract on behalf of the Authority shall be made by the Chairperson or such other officer as may be authorised, and shall be authenticated in the prescribed manner.

sections.section_title: Power of the Authority to charge fees, rent, etc.
sections.text: The Authority may charge such fees or rent as it may deem fit for facilities or services provided by it at airports, civil enclaves and aeronautical communication stations.

sections.section_title: Power of Authority to levy development fees at airports
sections.text: The Authority may, after the previous approval of the Central Government, levy and collect development fees at airports at such rates as may be prescribed, for the purposes of funding or financing the development of airports or any facilities thereat.

sections.section_title: Additional capital and grant by Central Government
sections.text: The Central Government may, after due appropriation, provide additional capital or make grants to the Authority for the purposes of this Act.

sections.section_title: Fund of the Authority and its application
sections.text: The Authority shall have its own fund, and all receipts shall be credited thereto and all payments shall be made therefrom; the fund shall be applied for meeting the expenses of the Authority and for the purposes of this Act.

sections.section_title: Allocation of surplus
sections.text: The Authority may, from its surplus, create reserves or allocate sums for particular purposes as it thinks fit, subject to any directions of the Central Government.

sections.section_title: Submission of programme of work and financial estimates
sections.text: The Authority shall submit to the Central Government each year a programme of its work and financial estimates for the next year.

sections.section_title: Submission of annual report and audited accounts
sections.text: The Authority shall submit to the Central Government an annual report of its activities and the audited accounts, which shall be laid before Parliament.

sections.section_title: Accounts and audit
sections.text: The Authority shall maintain proper accounts and other relevant records and prepare an annual statement of accounts; the accounts shall be audited by the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India.

sections.section_title: Submission of directions by Central Government
sections.text: The Authority shall be bound by such directions on questions of policy as the Central Government may give in writing from time to time.

sections.section_title: Power of the Central Government to temporarily divest the Authority of the management of any airport
sections.text: If the Central Government is of opinion that circumstances have arisen which render it necessary in the public interest, it may temporarily divest the Authority of the management of any airport and entrust it to any other person or authority.

sections.section_title: Power of Central Government to supersede the Authority
sections.text: If the Authority is unable to perform or has persistently made default in the performance of its duties, or has exceeded or abused its powers, the Central Government may supersede the Authority for a specified period.

sections.section_title: Power of Central Government to issue directions to the Authority in emergency
sections.text: In the event of war or other emergency, the Central Government may issue directions to the Authority, and the Authority shall comply with such directions.

sections.section_title: Power to make rules
sections.text: The Central Government may, by notification, make rules for carrying out the purposes of this Act.

sections.section_title: Power to make regulations
sections.text: The Authority may, with the previous approval of the Central Government, make regulations consistent with this Act and the rules made thereunder.

sections.section_title: Rules and regulations to be laid before Parliament
sections.text: Every rule and every regulation made under this Act shall be laid before each House of Parliament.

sections.section_title: Power to remove difficulties
sections.text: If any difficulty arises in giving effect to the provisions of this Act, the Central Government may make such order not inconsistent with the provisions of this Act as appears to it to be necessary or expedient for removing the difficulty.

sections.section_title: Repeal and saving
sections.text: The International Airports Authority Act, 1971 and the National Airports Authority Act, 1985 are repealed; the provisions of section 6 of the General Clauses Act, 1897 shall apply to such repeal.
